maddeler.e:
نتأمرك (form IIq)
# نَتَأَمْرَكُ (nataʔamraku) /na.ta.ʔam.ra.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# نَتَأَمْرَكَ (nataʔamraka) /na.ta.ʔam.ra.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# نَتَأَمْرَكْ (nataʔamrak) /na.ta.ʔam.rak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
